Channel Mapping Info
fields.options:
Multi-Storefront Configuration

How it works:

  • Map Item Groups to specific Sales Channels above
  • Products inherit channel visibility from their Item Group
  • Add Item Groups to 'ALL Channels' list to make products visible everywhere
  • Override per-item via the Item form (Shopware Sales Channels section)
  • NEW: Manufacturer Filter - Optionally filter by Brand/Manufacturer per mapping

Priority: Item Override > Item Group Mapping (with Brand Filter) > Default Channel

Tip: Use Manufacturer Filter to create brand-specific storefronts from a shared product catalog.

Smart Collections drive Shopware channel visibility and category membership. Each collection's rules resolve to an item set per Sales Channel; the resulting Shopware category, its salesChannels association and the items it contains are managed by the sync. Visibility level (10/20/30) is configurable per target.

Manage collections under Smart Collections. The list below summarises the current state for this backend. Item Group Channel Mappings above are deprecated and migrated automatically.

Price Handling Info
fields.options:
Price Handling

B2B Mode (Net Prices): Shopware stores gross prices. When importing, gross is converted to net using the tax rate from the order. Taxes are added separately.

B2C Mode (Gross Prices): Prices are imported as-is from Shopware (gross/inclusive of VAT).

German Law: B2B invoices typically show net prices + VAT. B2C invoices show gross prices including VAT.
